note: Set A covers both section scales (West/C1 and East/A1), both datum elevations, and the full revision record with correctly bound dates and descriptions, and it keeps the section conditions on the finished-floor claims. Set B invents a "Section B" condition for the finished floor (B is a grid/section marker, not a section containing that datum) and garbles the East Module scale value as "3/8\" 1'-0\"". Both sets repeat the same grade-level, finished-floor and West-Module-scale facts several times under slightly different names, but A's coverage of the page's engineering content is broader and free of misbound or misread values.
remarks: Both extractions state the same datum facts three times (Grade Level 0'-0" and Finished Floor 2'-9 1/2") and repeat the West Module / C1 scale under two names; C1 IS the West Module section and A1 the East Module section, so these should be collapsed. Set A's "Project | name | U.S. DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY SOLAR DECATHLON 2013" concatenates the client block and the event logo text; it is administration and neutral here, but the binding is loose.
